cover_letter.subject: Application for Global Research - Junior Economist - Analyst or Associate
paragraphs: I am applying for the Global Research - Junior Economist - Analyst or Associate role at JPMorgan Chase. My background combines econometrics, international and development economics, and applied data work, with training from Université Paris Dauphine and Maastricht University. I am particularly interested in contributing to economic research through quantitative analysis, database work and written outputs.

At Dauphine, I completed a Master 2 in Econométrie, Économie Internationale & Développement with advanced econometrics, public policy evaluation, environmental economics, industrial economics, quantitative methods and statistical analysis. My applied work used R and Stata for regressions, panel data and difference in differences. In parallel, my current and recent projects involved Python, DuckDB, SQL, Excel, CSV and Parquet, including a pipeline covering 43 years of local fiscal files and about 1.56 million commune-year observations.

My experience also matches the reporting and synthesis aspects of the role. At Greenly, I produced indicators, dashboards, slides and reporting materials for clients and internal teams, and wrote methodology documentation on carbon reporting, SBTi, FLAG and transport analyses. In the DataForGood / Reclaim Finance project, I documented variable definitions, schema normalization and quality checks while building territorial indicators on fiscal vulnerability to climate risks. I also worked on a master thesis about green industrial transition using input-output data, Eora26 and Exiobase, which strengthened my ability to synthesize evidence from large datasets and present findings clearly.

I would welcome the opportunity to support JPMorgan Chase Economic Research Team with data gathering, statistical analysis, database updates and written research outputs. Thank you for your consideration, and I would be pleased to discuss how my background can contribute to your global research work.
